CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 38
   C. 60
   D. 30

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

3. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

4. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 36
   C. 6
   D. 18

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 15
   C. 22
   D. 44

7. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

8. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

9. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 49

10. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

11. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.6
   C. 23
   D. 23.7

12. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 21

13. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.6
   D. 31.7

14. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 43

15. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 31
   D. 1

16. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
